item.title: Annexation of Nelson Drive moves forward
item.description: JACKSON, Wyo. — Town Council passed a motion unanimously on Tuesday evening to move forward with the requested annexation of the United States Forest Service land on Nelson Drive. item.title: Long dry spell continues with limited snowfall potential
item.description: JACKSON, Wyo. – Persistent high pressure will continue to result in dry conditions in the Tetons with limited opportunities for meaningful snowfall over the next 7-10 days at least. High temperatures will generally be in the 20s to 30s with overnight lows in the single digits to near zero. item.title: Jackson’s bighorn herd featured in WGFD film on sheep management
item.description: JACKSON, Wyo. — The Wyoming Game and Fish Department (WGFD) has premiered a 12-minute video exploring the history and management of bighorn sheep in Wyoming. The documentary-style short, Carrying Capacity, discusses how population size can impact the health of a herd. item.title: TOJ announces new Deputy Town Manager David Garcia
item.description: JACKSON, Wyo. — Following a nationwide search, the Town of Jackson (TOJ) has appointed a new Deputy Town Manager.
